Hanabi · Clues. Goal: Build the red and blue piles in order 1, 2, 3 with your two teammates. Every built card is a team point; completing both piles within six turns adds 6, for 12. Your turn: Six turns. Play one of your own cards, or spend one of three clue tokens on a teammate: A live player chooses a card to play from the clue and its observations. Scoring: Team score only: built cards plus the completion bonus. A card that is not the next rank for its colour is discarded. Rivals: A live player controls each other seat, choosing its actions from its own observations and the game history. Your cards are hidden from you; each teammate sees the other hands but not their own. A teammate chooses a free rank clue for you before each turn.
Round 3/6. Scores: [1, 1, 1].
Last resolution: Clue accepted. Clue to player 1: player 1, R. They played slot 2: ['R', 1]; built.
